name: asto-office
description: ASTO Office — private business management and quotation application for ASTO SECURITY

scripts.db:seed:local: tsx scripts/gen-seed.ts > .wrangler/seed.sql && wrangler d1 execute asto-office-db --local --file .wrangler/seed.sql
scripts.db:reset:local: rm -rf .wrangler/state && npm run db:migrate:local && npm run db:seed:local
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:check && npm test && npm run build && wrangler deploy --env production
scripts.db:migrate:prod: wrangler d1 migrations apply asto-office-prod --env production --remote
scripts.backup:prod: mkdir -p backups && wrangler d1 export asto-office-prod --env production --remote --output backups/asto-office-prod-$(date -u +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).sql
